title: Jointly conservative exact functors detect short exact sequences
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D_i$ ($i\in I$, where $I$ is a set) be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], and let $L_i:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D_i$ be functors preserving zero morphisms, finite limits and finite colimits. Assume they jointly reflect isomorphisms: for any morphism $a$ of $\mathcal C$, if every $L_i(a)$ is an isomorphism, then $a$ is an isomorphism. For any short complex $S=(A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C)$ in $\mathcal C$, with $g\circ f=0$, the sequence $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ is short exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] if and only if $0\to L_i(A)\xrightarrow{L_i(f)}L_i(B)\xrightarrow{L_i(g)}L_i(C)\to0$ is short exact for every $i\in I$.
